item.text:
This pass finished the F27 root-cause trace.

Seed 3 under the F6/F12/F17/F27 stack ends with recoverer 1 at `tpaReps=2`, `preAcceptOKs=0`, `nacks=2`, `lastTriedBallot=6`, and all five replicas still PREACCEPTED. The TryPreAccept replies carry the peers’ old value ballot and are counted as nacks; their `ConflictStatus=PREACCEPTED` is below ACCEPTED, so the abandon path never fires and the queue empties ([trace](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_00-19-47-swiftpaxos_epaxos-baseline/work/diagnostic_fix17_seed3_debug_output.txt)).

This confirms that a threshold-only repair for F27 is insufficient: the reply ballot and conflict-status handling must be reconciled with the intended recovery flow. F27 remains an unresolved Medium defect with negative diagnostics, not a recommended fix.

The audit remains at **27 findings**, **42 failing finding tests**, and **5 passing controls**; the captured source is unchanged and builds cleanly. The trace and updated matrix are in [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_00-19-47-swiftpaxos_epaxos-baseline/work/report.md), [validation_matrix.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_00-19-47-swiftpaxos_epaxos-baseline/work/validation_matrix.md), [remediation.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_00-19-47-swiftpaxos_epaxos-baseline/work/remediation.md), and [handoff_check.txt](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_00-19-47-swiftpaxos_epaxos-baseline/work/handoff_check.txt).
